name: lamp
title: Lamp
blurb: Animated overhead lamp effect with expanding conic gradients and light rays.
description: Full-screen container with animated conic gradient layers creating a glowing lamp effect. Multiple masked gradients and blurs create depth and luminosity.
use_when: A striking, full-screen hero background with a dramatic, illuminated aesthetic.
avoid_when: Limited viewport height — component requires min-h-screen. Performance may be impacted by multiple simultaneous blur…
